Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J32/J32nB272.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Hongzhi Jue of Tiantong Jingde Monastery, Mingzhou. Hongzhi Zhengjue owns the retained raising: a monk asked Yunmen — I do not raise a single thought; is there still fault or not? Yunmen said: Mount Sumeru. And Hongzhi's verse: not raising a single thought, answered with Sumeru — the tongue is one strip of flesh, the lips two sheets of skin; so marvelous, Yunmen's device — it falls into neither knowing, not-knowing, nor right and wrong.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB218.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Lanshi Ling. Lanshi Ling owns the retained raising: a monk asked Yunmen — this student does not raise a single thought; is there still fault or not? Yunmen said: Mount Sumeru. Jingming is not so: if today a fellow came out and asked — this student does not raise a single thought; is there still fault or not? — I would answer him: the jeweled crown on the heaven-king's head. Assembly, tell me: are this mountain monk and Yunmen the same, or different? Settle it, and the staff is handed over to you with both hands; failing that, the staff will carry a message for you all. And he threw it down.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB452.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Lüyan He. Lüyan He owns the retained raising: a monk asked Yunmen — I do not raise a single thought; is there still fault or not? Yunmen said: Mount Sumeru. The master said: that monk had no way to turn his body; Yunmen opens a way through everywhere he touches. If you get it before the case is even raised, you will walk sideways across the world; failing that, you are all crushed under Mount Sumeru. This mountain monk does not grudge his eyebrow-hairs, and verses it further: it only wants the right eye of the person himself open — what has it to do with raising thoughts or not? Shaoyang held up Sumeru the king of mountains — one blow, and empty space splits into seven or eight pieces. Truly enviable: every land and every dust reaches its home village; across and against, all is expedient.

Senses.Explanation: Not raising a single thought — is there still fault or not? The probe that prices stillness, sealed with one mountain. At the root, in Yunmen Wenyan's question hall: asked — I do not raise a single thought; is there still fault or not? — one word: Mount Sumeru. Hongzhi Zhengjue, raising it: so marvelous, Yunmen's device — not raising a single thought, answered with Sumeru: the tongue is one strip of flesh, the lips two sheets of skin; it falls into neither knowing, not-knowing, nor right and wrong. Baoning Renyong, in his verse: standing all awry on the ten-thousand-fathom peak, one blink of the eye and you drop off the cliff; whole body without the least harm — in heaven above or among men below, who would dare bury him? Wuyi Yuanlai, in his comment: not raising a thought — a three-foot sword held crosswise; Mount Sumeru — one hair fallen from it; twenty years Boshan could not find his opening, and it was from here he came to know Yunmen. Lanshi Ling, countering: Jingming is not so — if a fellow asked today, I would answer him: the jeweled crown on the heaven-king's head; are this mountain monk and Yunmen the same, or different? settle it, and the staff is handed over with both hands — and he threw it down. Lüyan He, ruling in his address: that monk had no way to turn his body; Yunmen opens a way through everywhere he touches; get it before the case is raised and you walk sideways across the world — failing that, crushed under Mount Sumeru; and the verse: it only wants the person's own right eye open — what has it to do with raising thoughts or not? Shaoyang held up Sumeru the king of mountains — one blow, and empty space splits into seven or eight pieces.
